task_description: Make Auto routing real on the v0.9.0 build. Feed the (already sound) routing engine real signal and filter the candidate pool so Auto meaningfully determines what model runs. Fixes the user-observed problems: ~48 Gemini models all falsely labeled 'streaming · tools · vision · json · free' (including non-chat models like embeddings/TTS/image/video/transcription), and routing to a stale model (gemini-2.5-pro) that 404s for new users. Deliverables: (A) filter enumeration to chat-capable models via Gemini's supportedGenerationMethods (+ name backstop); (B) real per-model capability detection replacing uniform stamping; (C) real cost (seed bundled defaults so cloud is not 'free', local stays zero) + a per-model quality tier feeding AutoDefaultPolicy so Auto/Prefer-Quality/Prefer-Local differentiate models; (D) 404/unavailable resilience (rank toward current models + verbatim error, optional fallback hop); (E) picker display shows the real caps/cost and no non-chat models. Update the spec. Provider-general, not Gemini-only. Do NOT push/tag/PR.

verification.summary: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox: cargo build/test/clippy are CI-ONLY (rustc 1.92 < AWS-SDK deps' >=1.94.1 requirement, crates.io 403) for EVERY crate including routing; npm test/lint/tsc are CI-ONLY (node_modules absent, npm 403). Runnable offline gates PASS: per-crate `cargo fmt --check` clean for providers/routing/orchestrator-core/tauri-app/persistence/domain; whole-frontend `prettier --check .` clean. Hand-audit CONFIRMED: all 13 AvailableModel construction sites set the new `quality` field (real builder uses quality_for(kind,id); every test literal sets it); no exhaustive destructure of AvailableModel/ModelInfo exists elsewhere so nothing else breaks. test_quality reviewed: new tests exercise real code paths and would fail if reverted - gemini list_models wiremock tests assert embeddings/TTS entries are dropped and generateContent models kept (fails if the supportedGenerationMethods filter is removed); auto_default ranking tests assert a higher-quality same-caps model wins at HIGH complexity (fails if the quality blend is removed); pricing test asserts a Gemini row is nonzero with empty user config (fails if the bundled_defaults seed is reverted); pipeline_e2e 404 test asserts the verbatim Google replacement-suggestion body reaches MessageError + the persisted Error message; picker test asserts a Gemini pro model renders under Cloud with real $1.25/$5 hint + real multimodal labels while a flash-lite renders with narrower labels and a zero-price local renders under Local as 'free'. Authoritative build/test/clippy gate runs in GitHub CI after the orchestrator pushes; behavioral proof is the user's Windows build.
